items.content_html: Flipslide is a lightweight, browser-based slideshow system that uses a modified Markdown format (`.md`) as the slide source. It runs entirely from local static files with no required external dependencies. Decks are plain text, trivially editable by humans or LLMs, and structured around a folder convention that keeps media organised.
